Subject: Scope spine: mapping ISO asset groups to FedRAMP sampling windows

Hi team,

I'm trying to reconcile the ISO 27001 scope document with the tentative FedRAMP sampling windows BlueWave requested. I've attached an updated ISO scope matrix (v2) that groups assets by service boundary and control family. Can you: 

- Review the grouping and flag anything that shouldn't be in the in-scope boundary for ISO (I focused on inference runtime + control plane services).
- Call out obvious evidence sources we can pre-collect for the FedRAMP sampling (logs, KMS attestations, snapshot windows).
- Note any conflicts with BlueWave's requested sampling window (they've asked for a 2-week window in mid-Sept).

We need a short decision by Friday so I can confirm with their audit team. Drive link is below.

Thanks — Aisha

Attachments: ISO_scope_matrix_v2.xlsx
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cISO-MATRIx

--
Aisha Rahman

Subject: Re: Scope spine: mapping ISO asset groups to FedRAMP sampling windows

Thanks Aisha — quick pass attached. High-level notes: 

- The ISO grouping looks reasonable. I moved the kv-store backup snapshots into a separate "persistence" bucket because BlueWave traditionally samples snapshots as part of continuity controls rather than runtime controls.
- For FedRAMP sampling evidence, prioritized artifacts: snapshot hashes, KMS rotation logs, ingress/egress flow logs, and the node provisioning audit trail. Those are easiest to extract on short notice.
- The only potential conflict: our scheduled maintenance blackout (2026-09-10 to 2026-09-18) overlaps BlueWave's requested mid-September window. If they insist on their window, we'll need an alternate sampling window or an exception.

I've exported a suggested sampling calendar as a PDF (fedramp_sampling_calendar.pdf). Please review column "Suggested window".

Karthik

Attachments: fedramp_sampling_calendar.pdf

Hi Aisha,

Thanks for the matrix and Karthik's calendar. A few clarifying points from the audit side: 

1) We prefer sample windows that avoid known maintenance blackouts so the sample reflects normal operation. If you can provide a 4-week window that includes 2 operational weeks (no maintenance) and 2 buffer weeks, that's ideal.
2) Evidence ask list (high priority): KMS key rotation history (12 months), VM provisioning audit trail, inbound/outbound network flow logs for the selected windows, and a snapshot of system time & timezone settings for host fleet.
3) For ISO mapping: it's acceptable to map an asset to multiple control families, but please annotate primary owners. Auditors will escalate ambiguous ownership.

If BlueWave can't shift, we can compress the sampling but will need a short memo acknowledging the operational blackout in the evidence binder. If you'd like, I can draft the wording.

Jen
Senior Auditor
Quantus Audit Services
jen.park@quantusaudit.com

Looping in a quick operational constraint from BlueWave: their internal freeze for year-end close is 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-26. Combined with our maintenance blackout, that makes their mid-September ask infeasible. 

Proposal: Offer two contiguous windows for the FedRAMP sample, either 2026-08-24 to 2026-09-06 (preferred) or 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-10 (fallback). The first keeps us outside both blackout periods.

Action items: 
- Aisha: confirm which assets we commit to for the compressed window.
- Karthik: prepare the snapshot extraction runbook for the preferred window.
- Grace: need your sign-off on the proposed windows (timeline impact + executive notification).

Marissa
Sr. Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

For scope: we'll commit the inference runtime, control plane API, KMS-backed snapshot store, and node provisioning logs. I'm marking primary owners in the ISO_scope_matrix_v2.xlsx drive copy now.

Karthik: please start the snapshot runbook draft (SEC-4821). Jen: appreciate the offer to draft the operational blackout memo — yes please, that will help keep the evidence binder tidy.

I'll notify BlueWave and ask them to confirm. Grace, can you sign off on the compressed window so I can lock the schedule?

— Aisha

- Loop in #security-compliance on Slack once BlueWave confirms so CS and Platform can schedule on-call coverage.
